To determine how many days before the deadline Mike will finish his reading, we can break the problem down into simple steps:

1.  **Calculate the total time required to read the book:**
    Mike needs to read a total of 200 pages. His reading speed is 10 pages per day.
    $$ \text{Days to finish} = \frac{\text{Total Pages}}{\text{Pages per Day}} = \frac{200}{10} = 20 \text{ days} $$

2.  **Identify the deadline:**
    The teacher has given Mike 30 days to complete the assignment.

3.  **Calculate the remaining time before the deadline:**
    Subtract the number of days Mike needs to read from the total number of days allowed.
    $$ \text{Days before deadline} = \text{Total Deadline} - \text{Days to Finish} $$
    $$ \text{Days before deadline} = 30 - 20 = 10 \text{ days} $$

Both my previous reasoning and the peer responses correctly identify that Mike will finish 10 days early. There are no discrepancies in the logic or calculation.

Final answer: 10
